layer_2_release_policy_gate.note: anomalous profiles are semantically misbehaving but cryptographically well-formed signed bundles, so the cryptographic gate approves them; they are surfaced by per-leaf inspection instead

layer_3_per_leaf_semantic_inspection.note: per-leaf semantic inspection flags any trace whose status is not SUCCESS or whose action is on the forensic sensitive-action list; on this synthetic corpus every anomalous profile carries at least one such leaf and no clean profile carries any
